description: This Java class provides centralized exception handling in a Spring Boot application for unmapped routes and HTTP method issues. It offers JSON error responses for API clients and redirects to documentation for root HTML requests.

classes.name: NotFoundControllerAdvice
classes.description: A controller advice class that handles 404 and method not allowed errors centrally for the application, providing JSON error responses or HTML redirects based on request type.

methods.name: handleNoHandler
methods.description: Handles NoHandlerFoundException; returns a JSON error response or redirects to /docs if the client requests HTML at root.

methods.name: handleMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Handles HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException; returns a standardized JSON error response indicating the method is not allowed.

methods.name: acceptsHtml
methods.description: Checks whether the incoming request accepts HTML responses based on the Accept header.
